PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.

2. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
